hooks.command: jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty" | { read -r f; case "$f" in */arpg/*.rs|*/arpg/*.toml|*/arpg/*.wgsl) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; cd "${f%%/arpg/*}/arpg" || exit 0; . "$HOME/.cargo/env" 2>/dev/null; if ! out=$(cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings 2>&1); then printf "%s\n" "$out" | tail -n 40 >&2; exit 2; fi; }
